subject.title: Gateway Dashboard chat buttons lose busy state after tab switch and can interrupt active runs

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or close it after another PR owns this issue?
rationale: The issue has an open closing PR, but that PR is stale/conflicting and changes session-state semantics, so the next step is an ownership choice rather than a safe new automated fix lane.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the useful active-run recovery intent while using current UI/Gateway lifecycle helpers.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: The contributor can update the existing branch and add redacted live Dashboard proof before another merge review.

options.title: Close after canonical replacement
options.body: If a newer PR becomes the viable fix path, close the stale candidate PR and keep this issue linked to the replacement.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the useful active-run recovery intent while using current UI/Gateway lifecycle helpers.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored both the adjacent Stop-after-reconnect fix and the dashboard-v2 chat surface.
